findings.governingReading: the sun begins to set
findings.explanation: An onset becomes a completed sunset.

findings.governingReading: this ruined castle
findings.explanation: The battle’s physical destruction becomes mere vacancy.

findings.governingReading: we can obtain food and warmth here
findings.explanation: mirror moon again replaces warmth with unsupported beds.

findings.evidenceJa: 勝てない戦いではない
findings.governingReading: it is not a fight we necessarily cannot win
findings.explanation: A guarded litotes becomes confidence in victory.

findings.governingReading: keep deceiving each other
findings.explanation: The pair’s mutually maintained façade becomes private self-deception.

findings.governingReading: a turbid, milky-white sky
findings.explanation: The sky’s distinct color changes to gray and “impure” adds a moral shade.

findings.highlight: The man is standing below the cloudy sky
findings.evidenceJa: 雨上がりの匂いを含んだ空
findings.governingReading: the man stood beneath a clouded sky carrying the smell left after rain
findings.explanation: The scene’s contradictory rain-washed scent disappears entirely.

findings.governingReading: break through Archer together
findings.explanation: The tactical objective is passage, not winning a standalone fight.

findings.governingReading: tipped toward Caster, did they, Rin?
findings.explanation: Archer’s intimate direct address to Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: Archer’s question is a loaded one
findings.evidenceJa: 重苦しいアーチャーの問い
findings.governingReading: Archer’s heavy, oppressive question
findings.explanation: Emotional weight becomes insinuation or rhetorical manipulation.

findings.highlight: I’m inhuman at the very end
findings.evidenceJa: ここ一番で、わたしは非人間だった
findings.governingReading: at the decisive moment, I proved inhuman
findings.explanation: Rin’s claim about her choice under pressure becomes an end-of-life statement.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka apologizes with her back turned
findings.governingReading: Her back apologizes that this is her sin
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit moral judgment of using Shirou as a sacrificial pawn disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 躊躇いのなかった背中がわずかに震えた
findings.governingReading: the back that had shown no hesitation trembles slightly
findings.explanation: The crack in Rin’s performed resolve loses its contrast.

findings.highlight: turn the gears of the engine
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路のギアをあげる
findings.governingReading: shift the gear of the Magic Circuit I had keyed on
findings.explanation: Shirou’s circuit metaphor loses the actual magical system and becomes a literal engine.

findings.governingReading: a sword identical to his
findings.explanation: The planned single projection again becomes a plural arsenal.

findings.highlight: as if he has no interest in her
findings.evidenceJa: 始めから視界に映していないように
findings.governingReading: as though she had never entered his field of vision
findings.explanation: Archer’s controlled visual disregard becomes lack of emotional interest.

findings.evidenceJa: 無能は無能なりに身を弁えたか
findings.governingReading: even an incompetent has learned his proper place
findings.explanation: Archer’s contemptuous status judgment becomes praise for power awareness.

findings.highlight: He emits an intent to kill
findings.governingReading: this time I will not let you escape
findings.explanation: The specific threat tied to their prior encounter disappears.

findings.governingReading: decided in a single exchange
findings.explanation: The combat unit changes from exchanged blows to elapsed time.

findings.governingReading: held out for several exchanges
findings.explanation: The unknown number of attacks becomes duration.

findings.highlight: look up at the sky powerlessly
findings.evidenceJa: 力を無くした体で空を見上げた
findings.governingReading: with my strengthless body, I looked up at the sky
findings.explanation: The body’s depleted state becomes a manner of looking.

findings.governingReading: an unbroken expanse of gray overhead
findings.explanation: The enclosing sky is reduced to a single cloud.

findings.highlight: It looks like the time from ten years ago
findings.evidenceJa: 十年前に戻ったかのようなソラ
findings.governingReading: a sky as though I had returned to ten years ago
findings.explanation: The visual comparison loses its object and becomes malformed temporal resemblance.
